summary: CPI Card Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a partial redemption of its 10.000% senior secured notes due 2029. On July 2, 2026, the Company issued a notice to redeem $26.5 million of the $265.0 million aggregate principal, at a redemption price of 103.000% of par plus accrued interest, with redemption effective July 15, 2026. This is a routine debt management action, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Watch for any impact on leverage ratios or future refinancing steps.
